_doc: Stations built from modules (scripts/board/station_gen.gd, docs/BOARDING.md). station_gen: "modules" builds every new station visit from this catalogue, "classic" from the bands of boarding.json kinds.station (a station visited before this switch existed stays classic: its memory has no `gen`). types: the station types, one picked per station by `weight`: modules ([min, max] modules besides the dock: the size budget), min (module id -> how many it must have), max (module id -> at most; else the module's own max), beds ([min, max] beds in each medbay room), names (pool for the station's name when the place and its theme give none). states: what the station is like now, one picked per station by `weight` x the region's tilt (regions) x the theme's (themes): powered (the chance a module has power; the dock always has), light (per room, by whether its module has power: weights of lit, flicker, red (an emergency light) and dark), breach (the chance a module other than the dock has lost its air; x the module's breach_mult), hack (the chance a door that touches an unpowered module is dead and must be hacked), card ([min, max] more card doors on the only door of a dead-end room, besides the checkpoint's), beds (the chance a bed works: on a powered module and on an unpowered one, emergency power), sentry (the chance a crossing is watched by a sentry), moods (operational only: friendly or hostile, by weight), crowd (who is aboard, by mood or `any`: spawn {count, mix} as boarding.json spawn.kinds, people {count, roles} as boarding.json people.kinds), text (a line said on arrival). backdrop: what the windows look out on (station_backdrop.gd): kinds by weight (planet, gas_giant), per region tilt, and the colours of each kind. modules: the catalogue. cells: the footprint, rows of characters (# wall, w window: a wall you see out of, kept only where space is right outside, . floor of room 0, 1-9 floor of rooms 1-9 (each room's floor is a rectangle), + an inner door cell (2 in a row, between two rooms), d a door connector cell (2 in a row on the edge), h and p a hall connector (hhphh on the edge: two doors and the pillar between), @ the hatch (2 in a row on the edge, the dock), space: nothing). stretch: {x: [column, min, max], y: [row, min, max]}: that column or row is repeated min to max more times. rooms: per room number, purpose (a boarding.json rooms key, or {purpose: weight}), corridor (true: a passage), props (the room's props instead of its purpose's, as boarding.json rooms). tags: dock, link (a spoke or a crossing: it must end in a module), crossing, exterior, observation, hub, core, checkpoint, secure, market, medbay. weights: per station type. max: at most this many per station. after: tags one of which the module it attaches to must have; not_after: tags it must not. leads: a tag; the module is placed only with a module of that tag on another of its connectors (the door between is a card door). clear: cells beyond its windows that must be empty space (kept so). breach_mult: x the state's breach chance. close: what an unused connector becomes (wall, or window where space is outside).

abandoned.text: Her lights are out. Something still moves in the dark.

half.text: Half her sections still have power. The rest are cold and dark.

operational.text: Her lights are on and her air is good. Somebody runs this place.
